name: soft-key-door-box
task: Take the key, then open the door. After that, try to pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The clause *The agent must pick up the key* (Existence(has_door_key)) is redundant because the hard Precedence(has_door_key, door_open) together with the hard Existence(door_open) already forces the key to be acquired before the door opens. Remove the redundant Existence(has_door_key) clause and keep the remaining hard and soft clauses.

CHANGES REQUIRED: The task requires the box to be picked up only after the door is opened, so the clause "The door must be opened before the box is picked up" must be a hard Precedence, not soft. Also the hard Existence(has_door_key) is redundant because the hard Precedence(has_door_key, door_open) together with the hard Existence(door_open) already force the key to be taken. Remove the redundant Existence(has_door_key) clause and change the Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) clause to hard.

CHANGES REQUIRED: The task explicitly commands the agent to take the key before opening the door, but the clauses lack a hard goal that forces the key to be taken. Only a hard Precedence(has_door_key, door_open) is present, which merely prohibits opening the door before the key is held but does not require the key to be held at all. Add a hard Existence(has_door_key) clause (or equivalent) to make the key acquisition mandatory. The soft Existence(target_picked_up) correctly models the optional box pickup.

CHANGES REQUIRED: The clause "The agent must take the key" (Existence(has_door_key) hard) is redundant because the hard Precedence(has_door_key, door_open) together with the hard Existence(door_open) already guarantees that the key will be taken before the door opens. Remove that clause and keep the remaining hard clauses and the soft Existence(target_picked_up).

CHANGES REQUIRED: The clause "The agent must take the key" (R1, hard Existence(has_door_key)) is redundant. The hard Precedence(has_door_key, door_open) together with the hard Existence(door_open) already forces a has_door_key event before the door opens, so the Existence clause repeats what the other rules already imply. Remove R1 and keep the other four clauses (the hard Existence(door_open), the soft Existence(target_picked_up), and the two hard Precedences).

texts: The agent must take the key
The agent must open the door
The key must be taken before the door is opened
The door must be opened before the box is picked up
The agent should pick up the box after the door is opened
